nodes.name: Rapid self-exothermic synthesis of Ru/NdOCl
nodes.procedure: The Ru/NdOCl composite was synthesized via a sol-gel process followed by a rapid self-exothermic reaction. The reaction reached thousands of degrees Celsius instantaneously, leading to the massive release of gaseous products and the collection of black Ru/NdOCl powders with an optimized Ru/Nd molar ratio of 2:1.

unit_operations.name: Self-exothermic reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: ...and a few-seconds reaction with the large heat release, the black Ru/REOCl powders could be collected

nodes.source_text: we propose one kind of ruthenium-coupled RE-OCl heterogeneous catalyst... by a rapid self-exothermic method... After the sol-gel process and a few-seconds reaction with the large heat release, the black Ru/REOCl powders could be collected, where Ru/NdOCl with the optimized Ru/Nd molar ratio of 2:1... was taken as an example... the reaction temperature reached thousands of degrees Celsius instantaneously leading the massive release of gaseous products, namely CO, NO, NO2, and CO2.
